description.en-US: The selling place this mapping enables a payment method at. Immutable for the same reason the channel mapping is: moving a mapping between points is disabling it on one and enabling it on the other, and doing it as an update would skip the validation the enable path runs.

The paymentinvoice payment method this point accepts. A plain identifier with no edge and no foreign key, as on sales_channel_payment_rel: the row it names belongs to another module. The mapping narrows the channel rather than widening it - a method not enabled on the point's channel is refused at payment time whatever this table says, so the enable path refuses to write one.

The merchant account this method's money lands in at this point - a payment profile owned by the Payment & Invoice module. A plain identifier with no edge, for the same boundary reason as the method. Optional: a method that settles no money through a gateway names no account.
